title: Publication-Safe Course Build

ciFast.note: Remote exact-commit verification begins after this locally verified candidate is pushed.

ciDeep.note: Broader course and independent-instructor evaluation remains separate research evidence.

deploy.note: Production deployment and exact-version re-audit are downstream of push and remote verification.

liveProvider.note: The browser acceptance workflow uses the shipped local Scion route; no deployed-build claim is made yet.

manualHuman.note: No instructor evaluation, accessibility certification, or classroom validation is claimed.

claims.summary: Setup recovery remains available across early lazy-chunk failure until a durable build boundary.
Approved builds retain original authority while recording the exact internally enriched execution map.
Weekly quiz coverage is strict without applying weekly identity and count rules to cumulative exams.
Blueprint review and Project actions remain inside the supported phone viewport.

boundaries: This contract records a locally verified predeploy candidate; remote CI, production deployment, and live re-audit are downstream facts.
The execution-map receipt authorizes only the exact map produced by the approved build; later edits require a fresh blueprint review.
The browser record proves the tested workflow and viewport geometry, not every browser, storage condition, or device.
Automated conformance and immutable receipts do not substitute for instructor review, factual certification, accessibility certification, or classroom validation.
